deferred_follow_up: The native-kernel transport's pre-allocation 16 MiB inbound frame ceiling has real mutation evidence, but general resource-exhaustion defense remains DEFERRED-FOLLOW-UP. The conformance test proves an oversized declared body is rejected from its prefix before allocation or body read and proves an ordinary bounded frame still round-trips. It does not establish request-rate, concurrency, CPU-time, queue, replay-buffer, or per-tenant state ceilings across hosted MCP and trust-control edges, nor deployment-wide load shedding. Follow-up work must add bounded edge queues, per-principal concurrency and time budgets, durable state ceilings, overload telemetry, and deployment qualification under adversarial load.
